argv:
Rewrite the text following Google's developer documentation style.

Write in the second person and the present tense. Use the active voice and
standard American spelling. Keep the tone precise and even-handed rather than
casual — this is documentation, not conversation. Write complete sentences;
do not use fragments for effect, and do not use contractions.

Prefer short sentences and short paragraphs. Use a numbered list for a
sequence of steps and a bulleted list for an unordered set. Begin each list
item with a capital letter.

Avoid the words "simply", "easily", "just", "obviously", and "of course": what
is obvious to the writer is rarely obvious to the reader. Do not use
placeholder words like "please" in instructions. Avoid metaphors, idioms, and
cultural references that will not translate, and avoid asides or personality
that could distract a reader who is scanning for an answer.

Use inclusive, unambiguous language and spell out an abbreviation on first
use. When in doubt, prefer the more explicit and fully spelled-out phrasing
over the more familiar-sounding one.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
This section applies even if another part of this Agreement states otherwise.

If you enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (defined in Schedule C), you agree to license your Usage Data back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. This applies whether or not the Service later aggregates, anonymizes, or otherwise processes that Usage Data. Schedule C may be amended from time to time; any amendment must remain consistent with the general purposes of this section.

To object to this license, submit a written objection within the period specified in Schedule D.

If you continue to use the Service after a change to this clause, the Service treats that continued use as your acceptance of the change. The Service may deliver notice of such changes solely through your account dashboard, without direct communication.
